logline: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
continuity_notes: First episode of the series. Establishes Juliana's humiliation and abandonment by her betrothed, Gerald, and her noble family in favor of her sister, Clarissa.

beats.text: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.
Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.
High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.
Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.
Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.
Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.
Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Why?
Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Gerald is waiting for me.
Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: Not anymore.
Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: What do you mean?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: Look for yourself.
Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Gerald?

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Why are you holding her hand?
Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Because he is marrying me.
Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: No...
Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You let me come here...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!
Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: I changed my mind.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You swore you loved me!
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: People change their minds, sister.
Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: And you knew?

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Of course I knew.
Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: How long?
Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Father...
Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Tell them this is a mistake.
Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Father... please look at me.
The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: Enough!

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.
Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Embarrassed you?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.
Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: And I am what?
Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: I am the daughter they choose.
Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

beats.speaker: MATRIARCH
beats.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.
Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: So that is what I was worth to you?
Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: You have nothing to offer me anymore.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.
Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value...
Close-up on Clarissa's radiant, conceited smile basking in Gerald's words.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: ...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.
Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.
Tight insert on Juliana's white-knuckled hand clutching the gown fabric.
Push-in close-up on Juliana's tearful face. Her trembling mouth straightens, her tear-filled blue eyes hardening from sheer devastation into cold, resolute defiance.
Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.
Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.
Cut to black.

logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 1's cliffhanger. Gerald has turned away from Juliana at the altar, leaving her devastated before the entire aristocratic congregation.

beats.text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.
Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: You are far too plain...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: ...far too silent...
Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.
Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Gerald... Look at me.
Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You gave me your word before both our families.
Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.
Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?
Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.
Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Father...
Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?
Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.
Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Do not disgrace us further.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You won't even look at me.
Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.
Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: That plain, old-fashioned gown.
Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: And that quiet little face.
Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Gerald needs a real lady...
Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.
High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

beats.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
beats.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.
Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

beats.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
beats.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.
Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.
Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.
Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.
Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...
Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.
Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

logline: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation.

beats.text: Medium shot on Lady Juliana standing abandoned near the altar in her white gown, clutching her mother's medallion to her chest.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Look at you...
Medium shot on the Lady in Gold Gown, smiling smugly in her gold gown beside Gerald.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: ...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here.
Close-up profile of Juliana's hand tightly clutching the jeweled silver locket against her breast, tears welling in her eyes.
Medium close-up on Juliana looking across at her sister with wounded pride.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You stole my wedding.
Medium two-shot of Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing together at the front of the nave.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Don't pretend you've earned anything.
Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown smirking derisively.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: I didn't steal what was never truly yours.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips, refusing to break down.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: This was my wedding.
Side medium shot of Gerald looking away impassively as the Lady in Gold Gown leans back against him.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: It was supposed to be.
Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown beaming triumphantly.

beats.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
beats.text: Now it is mine.
Low-angle wide shot of an imperious Noble Matriarch in a lavish black velvet gown and jeweled tiara stepping forward.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Enough, Juliana.
Medium close-up of the Noble Matriarch glaring down with icy contempt.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.
Close-up on Juliana, tears shimmering in her eyes as betrayal strikes deep.
Medium shot on Juliana as she speaks out against her family's injustice.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: I was humiliated by your family.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: And my father said nothing.
Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Your father has made his choice.
Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: And what happens to me?
Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: You leave.
Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Leave where?
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Wherever a discarded daughter belongs.
Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: This is my mother's church.
Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: I have every right to stand here.
Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Not anymore.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Your father has chosen his family...
Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: ...and it isn't you.
The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: Guards! Remove her!
Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Let me go!
Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Please! Someone!
The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: Take your hands off her.
Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: Stand aside, stranger!
Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: I said...
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: ...let her go.
Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: Are you hurt?
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.
Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.

beats.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
beats.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!
Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: I can...
Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...
Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: ...to remember your worth.
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Why are you doing this?
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: Because I want to.
Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: You came here to become a wife.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: They took that from you.
Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: I am offering it back.
Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: I know enough.
Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.

beats.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
beats.text: Lady Juliana... accept my hand.
Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.
Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.

logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

beats.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.
Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.
Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Look at him.
Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.
Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.
Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.

beats.speaker: CLARISSA
beats.text: How fitting.
Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

beats.speaker: CLARISSA
beats.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You heard what they think I am.
Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Why would you offer me your name?
Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Because I know what I see.
Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: And what do you see?
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: A woman who was betrayed.
Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
Medium close-up of Juliana.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You don't know what my family has done to me.
Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: I know they have made you stand alone.
Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You don't have to stand alone now.
Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.
Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I will not become anyone's charity.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.
Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: It is a vow.
Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I don't know this man.
Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.
Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.
Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Then I accept.
Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.

beats.speaker: THE PRIEST
beats.text: My- My Lady...
Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.

beats.speaker: THE PRIEST
beats.text: Are you certain?
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I am.
Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.

beats.speaker: THE PRIEST
beats.text: Then... let us proceed.
Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You need not say anything you do not mean.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I truly mean it.
Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You have my protection.
Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You have my respect.
Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: And you have my word.
Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.

beats.speaker: THE PRIEST
beats.text: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...
High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.

beats.speaker: THE PRIEST
beats.text: ...husband and wife!
Dramatic musical chord swelling.
Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: You have thrown yourself away!
Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: For a penniless nobody!
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I would rather choose my own life...
Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.
Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!
Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: You are disowned!
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Come, Lady Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.
Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

logline: Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 4's ending where Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walked out of the chapel doors into the daylight after completing their wedding vows.

beats.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands clutching an ancient, brass-bound leather ledger against the skirt of her white wedding gown as she walks.
Juliana grips the heirloom ledger tightly against her waist, her posture resolute despite the tension.
Wide shot tracking Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man descending the grand stone steps of the cathedral courtyard. Behind them, Lord Ashcroft emerges from the vaulted doorway leaning on his cane.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: Miss Ashcroft.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: Then leave as his wife.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: Your dowry is revoked.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: Your inheritance is revoked.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You truly mean it? You are my father!
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.

beats.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
beats.text: And you have chosen to become a stranger.
Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: No, Father. You chose that long before today.
Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: Enough sentiment.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: And the ledger...
Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: ...that belongs to this family.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her.
Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.

beats.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
beats.text: Then you should have guarded it better.
Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Barbara, don't!
A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.

beats.speaker: CLARISSA
beats.text: Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.
Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana's trembling hand reaching toward the leather ledger resting in the puddle.
Wide shot of Juliana kneeling on the damp ground as the tall Mysterious Bearded Man strides purposefully into frame toward her.
The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
Close-up of his large, weathered hands gently lifting the wet, embossed leather book from the ground.
Medium two-shot as he holds out the retrieved ledger and places it into Juliana's trembling hands.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Here you go.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking warmly down at Juliana, his rugged face full of quiet sincerity.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: They destroyed it.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: They dirtied it. That is not the same thing.
Medium two-shot of Juliana pressing the soiled book tightly against her chest, weeping softly.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It was my mother's.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Then keep it.
The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Let them keep everything else.
Low-angle shot of Gerald standing high on the stone steps, grinning arrogantly as he points an accusatory finger down at them.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Look at you.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!
Over-the-shoulder shot behind the Mysterious Bearded Man looking up toward Gerald on the stairs. Gerald's arrogant grin slowly wavers.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Choose your next words carefully.
Extreme close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand completely covering and protecting Juliana's hands where they clasp the book.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Come.

High wide shot from above the courtyard archway. Juliana, holding her mother's book, and the Mysterious Bearded Man, holding her hand firmly, walk together down the wet cobblestone path and through the towering iron gates into the misty rain, leaving her former family behind as the screen fades out.
Rain gently pattering on cobblestones beneath a sweeping, melancholic orchestral swell that slowly fades to black.

logline: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 5, as Juliana and her mysterious new husband leave the Ashcroft estate behind and venture out into the rainy countryside.

beats.text: Medium full tracking shot of Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man trudging along a muddy, rain-soaked path in the dark woods.
Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.
Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.
Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.
Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: I know this is not the life you came from.
Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: No.
Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It isn't.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight.
Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.
Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I suppose the day was already ruined.
Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.
Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.
They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: That is it?
Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: Yes.
Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.
Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.
The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: I am sorry.
Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You came from comfort.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: This is all I can give you now.
Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It is quiet.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Very quiet.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.
Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I think I like that.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You are not disappointed?
Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I am.
Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: But not because of you.
Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: You don't have to do that tonight.
Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.
Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.
Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.
Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: There.
Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.

beats.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
beats.text: It is not much.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It is enough for tonight.
Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I lost my home today.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: My family.
Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Everything I thought my life would be.
Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: And yet...
Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's profile, his scarred cheek illuminated by the amber glow as he watches over her protectively.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid.
Close-up on Juliana looking up into the room with quiet hope in her blue eyes.
Close-up on the crackling flames and glowing embers of the fireplace, slowly fading to black as the music swells warmly.
Warm hearth crackles blending with gentle string music fading out.

logline: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 6, where Juliana found refuge and warmth beside the hearth with her mysterious husband; morning brings unwelcome visitors from her former life to their humble doorstep.

beats.text: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the cold, damp ground outside the stone cottage, pulling weeds from the dirt with her bare hands.
Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.
Low-angle tracking shot as an ornate black-and-gold carriage with crest emblazoned on the door rolls to a stop on the muddy path outside the gate.
Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.
Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

beats.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
beats.text: This is where you live now?
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier.
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You came all this way just to insult my home?
Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

beats.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
beats.text: Home? Look at your hands, Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

beats.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
beats.text: You look like a servant.
Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: You were born a lady.
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: And I remain one.
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort.
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You have no authority here. Leave.
Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: And your husband?
Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Where is that beggar husband?
The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.

beats.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
beats.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: We are leaving.
Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.

beats.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
beats.text: Leaving? Gerald!
Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
Carriage door slamming shut.
Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.
Medium profile two-shot of Juliana turning toward the Scarred Bearded Man, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You didn't say a word.
Close-up on the Scarred Bearded Man looking down at her, his rugged features softening with quiet affection.

beats.speaker: SCARRED BEARDED MAN
beats.text: I didn't need to.
Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.
Close-up of Juliana looking after him, a radiant and grateful smile blooming across her face as the scene fades out.

logline: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
continuity_notes: Picks up after Episode 7, where Alexander chased off Gerald and the mocking aristocratic visitors; quiet and intimacy now return inside the woodland cottage as evening approaches.

beats.text: Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.
Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.
Close-up on Juliana's hands carefully unlatching the metal clasp on the leather book.
Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Mother spent years writing this.
Medium shot as Alexander enters the dim room behind Juliana, quietly stepping up to the rustic table.
Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
Low-angle medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward Alexander in pleasant surprise.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Yarrow.
Close-up of Alexander looking down at her, the firelight catching the rugged scar across his face.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Good for wounds. Fever, too.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: How do you know that?
Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.
Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You know more about healing than you let on.
Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Enough to survive.
Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Your hair and beard...
Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.
Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I could trim them for you.
Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Not yet.
Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Not yet?
Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Let them grow.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?
Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It has advantages.
Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Very well.
Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.
Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: We'll see.
Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.
Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: My mother wrote the same thing.
Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: And the scars... were they from the war?
Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Some were.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It must have been terrible.
Close-up of Alexander lifting his gaze, heavy with past battles.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It was.
Medium two-shot of Juliana smiling tenderly at him across the open book.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.
Wide shot framing the warm silhouette of the two companions sitting peacefully beside the blazing stone hearth.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Perhaps I was wrong.
Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.

beats.text: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.
Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.
Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Stay back. I'll open it.
Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!
Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Bring him here. Quickly.
The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?
Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.
Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Feverfew... Not alone.
Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Chamomile... and willow bark.
Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Wait.
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: His fever... it's breaking.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

beats.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
beats.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Then we will face it together.
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: What rumor?
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Where?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

beats.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
beats.text: No one seems certain.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Then let it remain a rumor.
Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Impossible.
Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.

logline: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
continuity_notes: Follows the ominous revelation from Episode 9 of rumors circulating about a scarred war veteran, cutting directly to the secluded cottage where Alexander arrives bearing fresh wounds.

beats.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.
Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.
A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander!
Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It is nothing.
Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: There is blood running down your arm.
Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: A cut from the tenant fields.
Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Sit down.
Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Now.
Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I need to see the wound.
Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It is only a scratch.
Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.
Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Dear God.
Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You have suffered terribly.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It is over.
Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Your scars disagree.
Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Does it hurt?
Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Not much.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You are a terrible liar.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.
Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.
Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Why do you look at me like that?
Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Because you are looking at me.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Hold still.
Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I am holding still.
Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Perhaps it is your hand.
Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.
Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.

Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.

logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after the intimate moment between Juliana and Alexander in Episode 10, interrupted by the ominous arrival of an aristocratic carriage carrying Gerald.

beats.text: Low-angle tracking shot of heavy carriage wheels churning violently through the muddy, waterlogged track.
Squelch of mud and the grinding rattle of carriage wheels under heavy rain.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Alexander standing outside the rustic stone cottage, watching the incoming carriage with tense apprehension.
Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.
Tight shot tilting up as polished black boots step down directly into the muck, revealing Gerald clad in an opulent burgundy double-breasted coat.
Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.
Medium shot of a uniformed Constable descending from the carriage, firmly gripping a wooden truncheon.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Gerald? What are you doing here?
Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: I came for something that belongs to me.
Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: What? When?
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: The last time I came here.
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You never even entered the cottage!
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander would never steal from you.
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Choose your next words carefully.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!
Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

beats.speaker: CONSTABLE
beats.text: I have received a complaint of theft.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: A complaint is not proof.
Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

beats.speaker: CONSTABLE
beats.text: Then a search will settle the matter.
Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!
Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: If he has nothing to hide...
Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: ...let the constable search.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Search it.
Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Let them.
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

beats.speaker: CONSTABLE
beats.text: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

beats.speaker: GERALD
beats.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
