continuity_notes: Following the aristocratic Lord's ruthless extortion of the young maid in his study, Episode 34 transitions directly into the crowded courtroom trial where the conspirators unleash their manufactured charges and false witnesses against Lady Juliana.

beats.text: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.
Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.
Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
[A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Do you deny possessing this book?
Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: No.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Do you deny using its remedies?
Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: No.
Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: I admit to healing the sick.
The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Silence!
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

beats.speaker: PRUDENCE
beats.text: Yes, Your Honor.
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Tell the truth.
Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

beats.speaker: PRUDENCE
beats.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: What did you see?
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

beats.speaker: PRUDENCE
beats.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.
Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Did she draw strange markings?
Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

beats.speaker: PRUDENCE
beats.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?
Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

beats.speaker: PRUDENCE
beats.text: Yes.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: You will speak when addressed!
Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: We have further witnesses.
Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

beats.speaker: TOWNSMAN
beats.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...
Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: And?
Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

beats.speaker: TOWNSMAN
beats.text: She became violently ill.
Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

beats.speaker: OLD WOMAN
beats.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!
Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: She calls it healing.
The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: The people call it poisoning!
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: What were their illnesses?
Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: Irrelevant.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: It is not irrelevant!
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!
Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: You admit you administered them?
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Yes.
Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Without the approval of a licensed physician?
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: There was no physician willing to help them.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: So I helped them.
Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

beats.speaker: LORD
beats.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.
Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: No.
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Think carefully.
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: I have.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Then let it be.
Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.

beats.speaker: LADY JULIANA
beats.text: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.
Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.
The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.
[Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Enough!
The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.

beats.speaker: JUDGE
beats.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft...

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.
The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

beats.text: Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.
Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: I will not die in that house.
Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.
She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.
Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.
The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.
Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.
Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.
Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother arriving beside the frosted wooden door frame under sharp hanging icicles, shivering violently from the freezing cold.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: This must be the place.
Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.
Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.
Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.
Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.
Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Alexander!
Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Mother?
She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: You're alive.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Mother.
She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: I buried you.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I know.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.
Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Most of them were.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Then how did you survive?
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I wasn't supposed to.
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: A traitor?

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Yes.
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: We were close to finding him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Then came the ambush.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: And you?

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I was shot. Left for dead.
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: How did you escape?
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Then why did they never tell us?
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Who?
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I spent three years trying to find out.
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: The ambush was not an accident.
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Someone wanted me erased.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Who?
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.
Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.
A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

beats.text: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.
Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Then why did they never find you?
Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Because they made certain no one would look.
Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Who?
Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Sterling... and Rupert.
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Rupert?
Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They knew where I was.
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: They gave you to the enemy?
Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They gave them my location.
Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They wanted the investigation buried.
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: And when you disappeared...?
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They declared me dead.
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: And Rupert took Ashbourne.
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: While the world mourned a dead heir.
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: And I mourned you.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I know.
Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: I trusted them.
Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You trusted family.
Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They used that trust against you.
Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Mother... Juliana...
Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.
Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.
Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Alexander...
Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: What?
Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: She did come to me.
Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Is she still at Ashbourne?
Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: No...
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Then where is she?
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: They arrested her!
Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: They condemned her.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They are marrying in two days...
Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Because before that wedding begins...
Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.
Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

scenes.scene_heading: INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY

beats.text: Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.
The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.
Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Every important family in the county should witness it.
Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: The wedding?
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: The transfer of Ashbridge.
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.
Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us.
Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.
Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.
Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Send the invitations.
Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.
Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.
Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

beats.speaker: BUTLER
beats.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Catherine's wedding.
Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: So it is finally official.
Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: And after the ceremony...

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: What?
Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: The sentencing of the condemned.
Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: They want the families to witness it.
Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: A public execution after a wedding.
Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Not just an execution. A warning.
Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: To whom?
Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.
Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.
Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.
Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: They think fear will make me beg.
Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I will not!
Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.
Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: They cannot take who I am!
Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?
Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.
Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: She was always stubborn.
Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.
Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.
Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.

beats.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
beats.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.
Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.
A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

logline: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
continuity_notes: Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate.

beats.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.
Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Why?
Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

beats.speaker: GUARD
beats.text: Because no one should die hungry.

beats.speaker: GUARD
beats.text: Eat it before they see.
Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Thank you.
Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander...
Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: ...are you safe?
Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Do you even know what happened to me?

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Do you know they condemned me?
Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: What if I die here?

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: What if I never see you again?
A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Keep him safe.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Wherever he is.
Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Let him live.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...
Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I will not give them my husband.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I will not betray him.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Bells.
Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: The wedding.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It's beginning.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Then I suppose I'm next.
Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander...
Dramatic cut to black.
A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up as the wedding bells toll for Rupert and Catherine's ceremony. While Juliana prepares for execution in the dungeon below, Alexander's coordinated strike to liberate the cathedral and reclaim his birthright begins.

beats.text: Low-angle tracking shot from behind wagon wheels framing laborers unloading wooden crates from a horse-drawn cart in the bustling town square.
Men in work clothes stack wooden crates onto the back of a large carriage as horses snort restlessly in the morning mist.
Medium close-up profile shot of a vigilant scout in a dark brimmed hat holding reins and surveying the street.
The scout stands quietly by a wooden rail, keeping a sharp eye on passing civilians.
Artistic framing through the spokes of a large wooden wagon wheel looking out across the cobblestones toward church spires in the distance.
Close-up of a disguised loyalist adjusting his flat cap, followed by a low-angle tracking shot of two men walking briskly over the wet cobblestones.
Wide symmetrical establishing shot of the grand Gothic cathedral entrance flanked by armed royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin hats standing on stone steps.
Four royal guards in red ceremonial tunics and tall black bearskin hats stand rigidly at attention with rifles on the grand cathedral staircase.
Medium shot in a nearby alleyway where two loyalist conspirators huddle beside bundles of hay, discreetly passing a folded message.
Close profile two-shot of the two loyalist soldiers watching the cathedral spires in the distance.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST SCOUT
beats.text: Six at the front.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
beats.text: Four more inside.
Medium over-the-shoulder shot of the two men conferring as townsfolk pass in the foreground.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST SCOUT
beats.text: And the east gate?

beats.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
beats.text: Ours.
Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.
A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.
Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.

beats.speaker: ROYAL SENTRY
beats.text: Stop!

beats.speaker: CART DRIVER
beats.text: Firewood for the kitchens, sir.
Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
beats.text: Sleep.
Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.
Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

beats.speaker: CART DRIVER
beats.text: The road is clear.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
beats.text: Tell the Duke.
Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.
Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.
Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.
Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.
Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.
Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Enough hiding.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Today, he comes home.
Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.

scenes.scene_heading: EXT. WOODEN OUTPOST / SNOWY PATH - DAY

beats.text: Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.
Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.
Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST
beats.text: Your Grace.
Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Secure the chapel.
Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.

beats.speaker: LOYALIST
beats.text: Yes, Your Grace.
Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: No more hiding.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I am taking back my house.
Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.
Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And I am bringing my wife home.
Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

logline: High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.
continuity_notes: Picks up right after Alexander commands his men to secure the chapel and vows to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana; inside the cathedral, the wedding guests arrive and the conspirators finalize their sinister plot.

beats.text: Wide establishing shot looking up at the imposing stone Gothic cathedral as noble guests in formal Regency attire ascend the grand steps.
Somber cathedral bells tolling and the distant murmur of arriving carriages.
Medium wide shot of an ornate black and gold royal carriage pulling up to the cobblestone courtyard. A footman in white gloves steps forward and opens the carriage door.

beats.speaker: FOOTMAN
beats.text: The Harrington family.
Medium shot as Lord Harrington in a tailored black tailcoat and white waistcoat steps down from the carriage, turning to extend his gloved hand to Lady Harrington, who gracefully descends.
Lady Harrington takes his hand and steps onto the pavement, clutching a velvet reticule.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today.
Medium two-shot tracking slightly as Lord and Lady Harrington pause arm-in-arm, taking in the gathering crowd of high society.
Low-angle shot from behind as they ascend the stone steps toward the arched cathedral entrance.

beats.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
beats.text: And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh.
Tight close-up profile of Lady Harrington, her eyes glistening with cruel satisfaction in the soft sunlight.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: Imagine Juliana seeing this.
Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.

beats.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
beats.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: Good.

beats.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
beats.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.
Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: We have an excellent view.

beats.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
beats.text: Of the wedding?
Close-up two-shot as Lady Harrington turns her head toward Lord Harrington with a dark, knowing smirk.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: And everything that comes after it.

Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Everything must go perfectly.
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.
High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

beats.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
beats.text: All entrances are covered?

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: Every one, my Lord.

beats.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Good.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.

beats.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
beats.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.
Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.

beats.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
beats.text: And its witch will be dead.
The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.
Wide symmetrical shot down the candlelit aisle as the double doors part, flooding the cathedral with brilliant golden daylight.
Close-up of Rupert turning his head sharply, his eyes widening in awe.
Framed wide shot of Catherine silhouetted in the bright doorway, wearing a breathtaking cream and gold imperial bridal gown with puffed sleeves and an exquisite sheer veil.
Majestic high-angle wide tracking shot following Catherine from behind as her magnificent cathedral-length veil trails down the aisle between seated guests.
Medium close-up of Lady Harrington leaning forward from her pew, utterly captivated.

beats.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
beats.text: She looks like a queen.
Medium shot of Rupert at the altar, a proud, possessive smile breaking across his handsome face.
Full shot as Catherine reaches the top of the altar steps. Rupert steps forward and takes her gloved hands into his.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: You look more queen than bride.
Tight two-shot profile of Catherine and Rupert clasping hands intimately, gazing into each other's eyes with shared aristocratic vanity.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin.
Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.

logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 40 where Rupert and Catherine met at the altar; Catherine halts the vows to stage a public humiliation of Juliana, unaware that Alexander's forces are already detonating the cathedral gates.

beats.text: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.
Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Wait.
Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...
Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.
Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Catherine...

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Bring her in.
Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.
Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: There she is.
Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

beats.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
beats.text: Look at her.

beats.speaker: NOBLEMAN
beats.text: She actually came back to the chapel.
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

beats.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
beats.text: Not as a bride this time.
Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.
High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.
Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?
Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Still arrogant. Still standing.
Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Come.
Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.
Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.
Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Nothing.
Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.

beats.speaker: PRIEST
beats.text: Shall we?
Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.
Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.
Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.
Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.
Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 41 where Alexander's forces breached the cathedral entrance; Alexander now steps through the ruins, halting the wedding and unmasking Rupert's illegitimate reign.

beats.text: Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.

Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Who are you?

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You already know.
Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander...
Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Juliana.
Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!
Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: We will not.
Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: I said arrest him!

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Why?!
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: Because we know who he is.
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Rupert...
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
beats.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

logline: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.

beats.text: Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: You're lying!
Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.
Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!
Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: I said arrest him!
Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: We will not.
Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Your Duke!
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

beats.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
beats.text: No. He is your Duke.
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: You have all been deceived!
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Read the first.
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.
Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: No...
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Read the names.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Lord Henry Sterling.
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Rupert Ashburn.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

beats.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
beats.text: My God...
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You sold my men to the enemy.
Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: I didn't!
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And when you believed I was dead...
Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You took my title.
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

beats.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
beats.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: I was told he was dead!
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.
Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Sterling handled the report!
Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.
Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.
Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: My Lord?
Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.
Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.

beats.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
beats.text: Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?
Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.

logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

scenes.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

beats.text: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.
The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.
Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.

beats.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
beats.text: Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.
Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.

beats.speaker: LORD STERLING
beats.text: You have no authority!
Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

beats.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
beats.text: I have more than enough.

scenes.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

beats.text: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!
Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

beats.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
beats.text: Do something!
Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Do you know what this did to me?
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I mourned you.
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I waited for you.
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I never stopped loving you.
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: You don't remember?
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!
Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You were never my Duchess.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: But I loved you!
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.
Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: No!
Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I loved you before all this!
Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Did you?
Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.
Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Her?!

logline: Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 44's climax where Alexander walked away from Catherine towards Juliana standing in chains at the church doorway.

beats.text: Full tracking shot following behind Alexander as he walks down the rubble-covered stone aisle toward Juliana.
Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, tears welling in her eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Alexander...
Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Look at me.
Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.
Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.
Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: Your eyes...
Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: It's you.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: It was always me.
Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: You're the Duke?
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: All this time?
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I chose you because you were kind.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You chose me when I had nothing.
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I chose you because you had honor.
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.
Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

beats.speaker: JULIANA
beats.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Alexander...
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: I didn't know!

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

beats.speaker: CATHERINE
beats.text: Wife?!
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

beats.speaker: ALEXANDER
beats.text: Before the Crown and before God...
